enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Wake up at 06:30. Open eyes. Sit up. Turn on DeskLamp. Stand up. Walk to bathroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene: showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on Light. Turn on WaterHeater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off WaterHeater. Turn off Light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on Light. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off towel. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up Phone. Check time. Pick up bag. Put Phone in bag. Turn off Light. Leave bedroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on Light. Open Refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Take out butter. Close Refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place on InductionCooker. Turn on InductionCooker. Crack eggs into pan. Add butter. Stir eggs. Take out bread. Place bread in Toaster. Press lever. Wait. Take out plate. Put eggs on plate. Take out toast. Put toast on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Stand up. Wash dishes. Place dishes in Dishwasher. Turn off InductionCooker. Turn off Light. Leave kitchen.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Put on lab coat. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Review chart. Walk to patient room. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Update patient records. Use computer. Answer phone. End shift. Walk out of building.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on Light. Open Refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close Refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Take out pan. Place on InductionCooker. Turn on InductionCooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cook. Turn off InductionCooker. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Wash dishes. Place dishes in Dishwasher. Turn off Light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV in air-conditioned room
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on AirConditioner. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Walk to computer desk. Turn on Computer. Turn on Monitor. Sit on chair. Move mouse. Click on browser. Browse websites. Open game. Play game. Use keyboard. Click mouse. Stand up. Turn off Monitor. Turn off Computer.
Turn on TV. Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Look at TV. Change channel. Continue reading. Close book. Put down book. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on Light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off Light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: watching TV or reading
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Pick up book. Read book. Turn off TV. Put down book. Turn off Light. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
